title: [CQ-I03] JetBrains managed VM interface
description:
Objective: Show provisioning/readiness/recovery, actual capabilities and actionable refusal reasons.

Deliverable: JetBrains managed VM interface. This is task I03 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): I02, R06, R10.
definitionOfDone: Provider-ready is not execution-ready or verified.
VM lifecycle controls operate only owned instances.
Fresh verification `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.note: RED: ManagedVmPresentationTest (7 tests: P1-P5 + bundle-key check) written against the LANDED I03a contract (vm-control.mjs ad8097f). Run in a git-archive HEAD snapshot (D:\projexts\moes-i03-snap) under the jetbrains-gradle lease, because the shared tree has an in-progress peer merge (MERGE_HEAD 2c306fbf, main into moe/work-2026-10-24) leaving conflict markers in moe-jetbrains/.../MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt + its test; not mine, untouched. `gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.toolwindow.ManagedVmPresentationTest` -> exit 1, :compileTestKotlin FAILED, only "Unresolved reference ManagedVmCommand/ManagedVmReport/ManagedVmKeys/ManagedVmPresentation" (main sources compile). Adaptations to the landed producer: rows drop 'collision' (foreign VM) and 'deleted' phases per the I03a handoff; cleanup is enabled only when a LAUNCHED-phase row exists; Refused(code) report for top-level producer codes (LEDGER_UNREADABLE, VM_CONTROL_FAILED, ...); decode takes the command so a schema mismatch is unreadable.

GREEN: ManagedVmPresentation.kt (pure, no Swing/IO). decode(command, stdout, exit, timedOut) never throws: timed out/nonzero exit/>64KiB+1/multi-line/non-strict JSON/trailing data/schema mismatch/missing or mistyped field/unknown phase or state/bad taskId/lower-case code -> Unreadable(fixed key); foreign or repeated instance name anywhere in the report -> Unreadable(NOT_OWNED). JSON read via Gson TypeAdapter<JsonElement>.read on a fresh (non-lenient) JsonReader, avoiding Gson.fromJson/parseReader which force lenient and the Strictness API (absent from older platform Gson). Top-level producer code -> Refused(code). readiness = 3 lines (literal JSON true only); strongProfile always STRONG_PROFILE_BLOCKED; rows hide collision (foreign) and deleted; actions single-flight, cleanup only with a LAUNCHED row. MoeBundle.properties +53 lines moved forward from step 3 so the bundle-key test passes now (13 known codes, 4 preserve reasons, no HTML/single quotes). Snapshot run `gradlew.bat test --tests com.moe.toolwindow.ManagedVmPresentationTest` -> exit 0, BUILD SUCCESSFUL; XML: tests=7 failures=0 errors=0 skipped=0 @20:24:02Z.

ManagedVmPanel.kt (Disposable): 3 readiness lines, the fixed strong-profile line, a JBTable (VM, phase, state, launch tries, task), Refresh/Reconcile/Clean up owned enabled from ManagedVmPresentation.actions, plus a note area (status notes + last action notes). run() re-checks actions(lastStatus, running), so it is single flight. A Task.Backgroundable does ALL IO off the EDT: the script via TerminalAgentLauncher.resolveBundledPath("scripts/local-runner/vm-control.mjs") (now internal; SCRIPT_MISSING, no process), the profile via RuntimeSelectionPolicy.profile, and node exactly as the supervisor does (LEGACY resolveNodeExecutable(); PROTECTED resolveNodeExecutable(nodeOnProtectedPath) + installedExecutable Accepted, else NODE_MISSING). It runs ProcessBuilder(node + args) as an arg list, cwd = the script dir, stderr Redirect.DISCARD, protectedDaemonEnvironment under PROTECTED, through CapturingProcessHandler.runProcessWithProgressIndicator(progress, 120s or 20min). Cancel gives CANCELLED; IOException gives FAILED. Clean up asks for confirmation first. Each action is followed by a status refresh. Refresh runs once on first show (HierarchyListener). dispose cancels the indicator, and late results are dropped. MoeToolWindowPanel +3 (tab after Accounts + Disposer.register). DEVIATION: MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt is NOT edited. It holds a peer merge's conflict markers in the shared tree, and its internal resolver members are already reachable from a fresh no-side-effect instance, so no hoist was needed. Bundle +1 (column.tries). Compile fix: arrayOf<Any>. Snapshot `gradlew.bat test --tests ...ManagedVmPresentationTest` exit 0, 7/7 @20:27:45Z.

VERIFY (no byte changes in this step).
(1) Mutants, applied to the snapshot copy by /tmp/i03-mut/run.py and restored after each (cmp identical=True): 8/8 killed, each by its named case only.
- M1 exec-from-provider and M2 string "true": P1.
- M3a instance-arg overload and M3b foreign name: P2.
- M4 cleanup while running: P3.
- M5 strongProfile follows verified: P4.
- M6a raw code text into Refused and M6b raw stdout into Unreadable: P5.
The panel's stderr discard (Redirect.DISCARD) is not headless-testable; it is checked by review.
(2) GATE. The pinned `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` cannot run here: WSL has no JDK. The shared tree also cannot compile: it has a peer's unresolved merge (MERGE_HEAD 2c306fbf, main into moe/work-2026-10-24), with conflict markers in MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt and MoeDaemonSupervisorTest.kt, and its staged build.gradle.kts moves to IDEA 2026.2.3. So, under the jetbrains-gradle lease, I ran the Windows equivalent in a `git archive HEAD` snapshot, overlaid with exactly this task's 6 files (cmp-verified identical to the shared tree): `cmd.exe /d /c "set GRADLE_OPTS=-Xmx512m&& cd /d D:\projexts\moes-i03-snap\moe-jetbrains && .\gradlew.bat test --rerun"`. Result: exit 0, BUILD SUCCESSFUL. The XMLs, all stamped 20:29Z, show 22 suites and 316 tests with 0 failures, 0 errors and 0 skipped; ManagedVmPresentationTest has 7 tests, 0 fail.
(3) SIZE: +617/-1, so 616 net, OVER the 400 cap. Per file: ManagedVmPresentation.kt +227, ManagedVmPanel.kt +179, ManagedVmPresentationTest.kt +153, MoeBundle.properties +54, MoeToolWindowPanel.kt +3, TerminalAgentLauncher.kt +1/-1. The plan's estimates (110/130/90) were low. Cutting further would drop requested refusal texts or decode guards. I will file an epic size-exception rail with the final numbers after step 5.
(4) No red suite.

Adversarial self-review over this task's 6 paths.
FIXED, real: a dispose before the background thread published its indicator left the run uncancelled, so a queued cleanup could outlive the project. Now disposed is @Volatile, run(progress) cancels itself when disposed is set, and execute starts no process once cancelled (+2 lines, +1 comment change). The full gate re-ran after the fix: compileKotlin executed, exit 0, 22 suites, 316 tests, 0 fail @20:31Z.
CHECKED OK:
- A foreign or duplicate name anywhere in a report makes it NOT_OWNED.
- Readiness or verification claims never unblock the strong profile.
- A double click or a dialog race re-checks actions and is refused.
- A missing script or node starts no process.
- Arguments are passed as a ProcessBuilder list, never through a shell. basePath uses forward slashes with no trailing backslash.
- stderr is discarded by Redirect.DISCARD.
- No .moe writes and no MoeProjectService or UPDATE_SETTINGS use.
- No EDT IO: profile, script, node and the process all run in the Backgroundable.
- UI prose comes from MoeBundle. Table cells are validated identifiers.
- Gson nesting is limited, and its JsonElement adapter is iterative.
RESIDUALS (theoretical, in the handoff):
- Captured stdout is unbounded until the timeout; the producer caps it at 64 KiB.
- A killed node may leave a multipass delete running; reconcile repairs it.
- A WSL-mode bindHost of 0.0.0.0 preserves everything.
- A Windows versus WSL ledger split matters for activation.
- Gson keeps the last of duplicate keys.
- Only headless tests ran, against IDEA 2025.2.

ManagedVmPresentationTest has 7 tests and 0 failures, stamped 20:36:42Z.

Independent QA mutants: 5/5 killed by their named cases.
- Allow a duplicate name: P2.
- Enable cleanup with any row, not only a LAUNCHED one: P3.
- Ignore trailing JSON: P5.
- Show collision rows: P2.
- Enable reconcile without a ready provider: P3.
The source was restored and its sha256 verified after each.

DoD:
1. PASS. readiness() always gives 3 separate lines, and only a literal JSON true counts for execution or verification. P1 covers null, "true", 1, {}, absent and false.
2. PASS. ManagedVmCommand.args has 2 parameters and yields exactly [script, verb, --project, basePath]. A foreign or repeated name anywhere in a report makes the whole report NOT_OWNED. collision and deleted rows are hidden. I checked against the producer: the regex matches lifecycle.mjs isOwnedInstanceName, the PHASES/STATES/LAUNCHED sets match, and the row shape matches statusReport.
3. PASS. strongProfile() is a constant BLOCKED, and there is no activation action. The daemon keeps verifiedLocal:false, and EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY is unchanged.
4. PASS. See the gate above.

Rails: no .moe writes, no settings sends and no Git writes in the diff. No forbidden patterns. IO runs off the EDT. Arguments go to ProcessBuilder as a list and stderr is discarded. The supervisor's node, PATH and env resolution under PROTECTED is mirrored through its side-effect-free constructor. The script resolves from the plugin bundle (build.gradle.kts local-runner/**).

Advisory only, not blocking:
- Producer codes VERSION_MISMATCH, MANIFEST_INVALID, PROVIDER_OUTPUT_INVALID, PROVIDER_COMMAND_FAILED and PROVIDER_OUTPUT_LIMIT have no specific text. They fall back to UNKNOWN_CODE with the code shown, which is safe. Worth adding in I05/I06.
- The residuals in the worker's handoff stand: unbounded stdout until the timeout, and WSL bindHost 0.0.0.0 preserves everything.

completionSummary:
CQ-I03 delivered (plan rev 1, 5/5 steps): a JetBrains 'Managed VMs' tab that consumes CQ-I03a's vm-control.mjs.
- ManagedVmPresentation.kt is pure. decode(command, stdout, exit, timedOut) never throws.
  - Unreadable(fixed key): timeout, nonzero exit, more than 64 KiB, more than one line, non-strict JSON, trailing data, schema/command mismatch, a bad field, phase or state, a bad code.
  - Unreadable(NOT_OWNED): any foreign or repeated VM name.
  - Refused(code): a top-level producer code.
  - readiness() gives 3 separate lines (provider, execution, verification); only a literal JSON true counts.
  - strongProfile() is always blocked. Actions are refresh, reconcile and cleanup only, single flight. Commands take no instance argument.
  - Fixed refusal text for 13 codes and 4 preserve reasons.
- ManagedVmPanel.kt: all IO runs in a Task.Backgroundable.
  - It resolves the bundled script and resolves node exactly as the supervisor does per profile; under PROTECTED the env is scrubbed.
  - ProcessBuilder(arg list, stderr DISCARD) runs through CapturingProcessHandler.runProcessWithProgressIndicator: 120 s, or 20 min for cleanup.
  - Cleanup asks for confirmation. A refresh follows each action. dispose cancels the run. No .moe writes and no settings changes.
- Wiring: MoeToolWindowPanel +3; TerminalAgentLauncher.resolveBundledPath made internal; MoeBundle +54. MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt is untouched, because it holds a peer's merge conflict.
DoD: 1 P1 plus mutants M1/M2. 2 P2 plus M3a/M3b; the producer ledger is the only ownership source. 3 P4 plus M5; there is no activation entry. 4 Gate above. Mutants: 8/8 killed by their named cases.
SIZE: +619/-1, 618 net, over the 400 cap. EPIC size-exception rail prop-30944337eea941b7b76576c1aa0938c5 filed, PENDING human; #governors pinged.
Residuals: unbounded stdout capture until the timeout (the producer caps at 64 KiB); a killed node can leave a multipass delete running (reconcile repairs it); WSL bindHost 0.0.0.0 preserves everything
